svg.aria-label: Onshore oil and gas production flow from the well to the gathering station, with the electrical system: drilling rig, ESP well and pumpjack well, manifold, separator, gas boot, wash tank, storage tank and shipping pump, compressor and flare, water injection pump, power pole, and transformer. Pick a number to read the explanation.
svg.text: GATHERING STATION (GS): separation, dehydration, storage, export
